summary: Pommes Appétit grows, stores, cuts and delivers its own fresh fries and peeled potatoes from a farm in Sint Kruis, Zeeland, Netherlands. It was set up by Marijn and Katrien, and the potatoes are grown on the Uitdewilligen family farm. The fries come in 9 mm, 10 mm, 11 mm and 12 mm thicknesses.
ownership: Run by founders Marijn and Katrien on the Uitdewilligen family farm
products: Fresh-cut farm fries in 9 mm, 10 mm, 11 mm and 12 mm thicknesses
Vacuum-packed, chilled bags of 1.5 kg or 10 kg, other sizes on request
Free sample packs for horeca businesses and fry shops
markets: Sample packs: Zeeland, East Flanders and West Flanders
facts: Potatoes kept in mechanically cooled storage at a constant 7 °C
Holds the Zeker Zeeuws Streekproduct mark since early 2021
No preservatives added, as stated by the company
limitations: The website does not publish the legal entity name, founding year, staff numbers or turnover.
Processing capacity, volumes, acreage and storage capacity are not published, and no plain-text email address is given.
The website names two different delivery areas on its home page and its sample-pack page.
